## Description

Runs the Stata package scanner (`tools/run_scanner.sh`) on the deposit to find user-written Stata packages the code may need. Needs Stata, so the pipeline runs it in the `larsvilhuber/bitbucket-stata` image.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/10_run_stata_scanner.sh <directory>
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory.

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `ProcessStata` - When `no`, the script exits immediately.

## Outputs

- `generated/candidatepackages.xlsx`, `generated/candidatepackages.csv`, and `generated/candidatepackages.md` (via `tools/csv2md.py`)
